title: PHANTOM GRID L0-L5 Full Stack Automotive Architecture
full_script: PHANTOM GRID Sovereign Automotive Architecture: L0 to L5 Full-Stack Penetration. Layer 0 to 1 CAN physical bus with rolling Alive Counter and SAE J1850 CRC8 validation. Layer 2 to 3 SOA SOME/IP gateway and edge autonomous healing engine with Level 1 and 2 derating. Layer 4 to 5 In-Vehicle MCP Server, HITL dual-signature governance, and Nostr fleet mesh broadcast. Fully verified, tested, and containerized for zero-hallucination deployment.
